claims.statement: Management expects to reach a capacity closer to 150,000 metric tons over a period of about 2 to 2.5 years.
claims.quote: Our feeling is that possibly over a period of about 2-2.5 years, we should be able to reach basically a capacity which is higher and closer to about 150,000 MT.

claims.statement: The company aims to maintain operating margins within a certain band going forward.
claims.quote: Going ahead, the whole idea is that we can still maintain a band of what we have been operating on.

facts.statement: The VAM-VAE backward integration project is designed as a future-generation technology focusing on low VOC and special paint properties.
facts.quote: It's a technology which is quite future generation oriented. It talks of low VOC. It talks about giving some special properties in paint it can garner.

facts.statement: Putty is considered the starting point of paints and signifies the first purchase a consumer makes for painting.
facts.quote: Putty is a starting point of paints. That segment is also important because it really signifies that it’s the first purchase a consumer is doing as far as painting is concerned.

facts.statement: Competitive intensity is present across all segments including economy, premium, and luxury.
facts.quote: As far as the economy products are concerned, today, the competition intensity is across, whether it is economy, whether it is premium and whether it is in luxury.
